items.title: SlothLabs spring releases
items.body:
**Mermaid Preview** (JetBrains plugin) is live. Up next: **CloudOrbit** + **WattsOrbit** ship together on **Friday May 29**, then **DataOrbit** lands on **Monday June 15**.

klight, ProxyOrbit, and BastionOrbit have all been moved to **TBD later in 2026** — we'd rather hold them until they're done than ship to a deadline.

All free, all native, all open source.

items.title: Advertise with SlothLabs
items.body: Reach thousands of macOS developers, infra engineers, and AWS/Kubernetes power users. Sponsored placements appear in every Orbit app's news tab and are clearly labelled.
